Not covered, so R1CS-SOUND and R1CS-COMPLETE stay 0: the one-constant-operand modes (a zero constant divisor halts, and constant/constant emits no constraint). In those modes snarkVM folds constants, so the emitted system is not the variable gadget. Abs of the constant operand and the sign-bit is_equal are free. The select condition becomes msb(x) or 1 - msb(x) (or a constant, choosing a branch with no constraint, while 0.sub_wrapped of the other branch is still emitted). For the checked forms, is_equal against MIN or -1 of a constant operand is a constant, so the AND and the assert fold. No theorem covers these folded systems, and no reduction lemma to the variable gadget with constant wires is proved.
